policy.owner: Orchestrator for planning; assigned dependency/knowledge custodian before operating reliance
policy.applies_to: Every claim record in this file explicitly inherits every policy field below; exceptions are recorded in the claim. Scope includes the entire primary-source tables of kernel13 and authority15, plus the lexical primitives in knowledge3.
policy.source_interests: Maintainers/providers document and promote adoption of their own systems and may sell hosting, support or related services; repository authors may receive sponsorship. Standards bodies specify a normative format, which does not validate an implementation. No claim of financial disinterest or independent source incentive is made.
policy.confidence_rule: Confidence is scoped to observed/reported source wording and exact version. Historical authenticity, present applicability, composed correctness, security sufficiency and business value are separate claims. Unmeasured dimensions remain unknown.
policy.date_rule: Record known source publication/version dates where captured; otherwise record unknown explicitly. Access date is an observation date only. Never infer a release date from a chosen version or substitute an access date.
policy.freshness_rule: A historical observation remains historical. Revalidate present reliance before final dependency locking and any operational admission, and on the earliest relevant upstream documentation, security advisory, maintenance/support, authentication/terms or specification correction even if the installed package has not changed. For living source reliance, schedule a check no later than30days after the last source review; earlier consequence-specific deadlines control.
policy.initial_latest_scheduled_check: 2026-10-12; first implementation dependency lock or operational reliance may require earlier verification
policy.expiration_behavior: Overdue, inaccessible or contradicted material loses eligibility as a sole current prerequisite; retain historical attribution, seek current primary evidence or a justified compatible alternate, and restrict only dependent claims/actions. An old URL or exact binary pin does not renew source applicability.
invalidation_conditions: Current primary text contradicts the recorded assertion or changes its scope/version/definition
A security or maintenance statement changes without a package upgrade
Selected version/flags/platform/authentication/terms differ from the cited scope
A controlled test contradicts documented behavior or exposes an unmodeled prerequisite
A cited observation cannot be reconstructed or a claimed independent audit did not examine that claim
policy.correction_behavior: Append the correcting observation and affected decision/contract references; preserve the earlier assertion and known limits. Reopen relevant selection/admission and tests rather than silently rewriting history.
policy.runtime_boundary: No metadata record issues a grant, funds infrastructure, establishes professional availability or certifies implementation. Source review and runtime conformance have separate acceptance records.
